xmldoc.short_description: Compute watershed regions of a 2-D image or 3-D volume.

param_input_item.param_description: Finite real 2-D or 3-D numeric or logical image.
Connectivity, 4 or 8 for images, 6, 18, or 26 for volumes. The default value is 8 for images and 26 for volumes.

param_output_item.param_description: Double label array. Watershed ridge elements are set to 0.

description.p: Compute watershed regions of a finite real 2-D image or 3-D volume.
Connectivity can be 4, 8, or an equivalent 3-by-3 matrix for images, and 6, 18, 26, or an equivalent 3-by-3-by-3 array for volumes.
Labels identify catchment basins, and watershed ridge elements are set to 0.
